items.name: Rate Limiter
items.description: Limit request volume using a sliding window. The limit applies gateway-wide when the policy is global, otherwise per consumer.

fields.label: Max Requests
fields.description: Maximum number of requests allowed within the window.

fields.label: Window
fields.description: Sliding window duration (e.g. 1s, 1m, 1h).

fields.label: Max Parallel Requests
fields.description: Optional. Maximum number of requests in progress at once, open streams included, counted across gateway replicas per the same limit per as Max Requests. A request over it is rejected with 429 and no Retry-After header, in Enforce and Throttle; Observe only reports it. A slot is freed when the response ends or, if a gateway pod stops, after two minutes; a heartbeat keeps a slot for at most one hour. Empty or 0 means no limit.

fields.label: Retry After
fields.description: Value sent in the Retry-After header, in seconds, when the limit is exceeded. Set to reset to send the seconds until the counter admits a request again.

fields.label: Group By Header
fields.description: Optional request header whose value sub-partitions the limit within the policy scope (e.g. X-User-Id). When empty, the limit is counted per gateway (global) or per consumer.

fields.label: Limit Per
fields.description: What each request counter belongs to. Absent is shared: one counter for the whole policy scope. application is one per application, api_key one per API key, group one per group of the group key (a request without a group counts toward its application), model one per model, and header one per value of group_by_header. api_key does not limit requests without a key, and application and group do not limit requests without an application.

fields.label: Applies To
fields.description: Whether application or group limiting covers all of them or only the ones in selected. A request without a group is never filtered by group selection: it counts toward its application. A request outside the selection is not limited by this policy.

fields.label: Selected
fields.description: Application ids, or group ids with limit_per group, that applies_to selected limits. Required and non-empty with applies_to selected.

fields.label: Only For Models
fields.description: With limit_per model, limit only the models matching one of these patterns (* is a wildcard, e.g. @openai/gpt-6-luna or gpt-5*). Empty limits every model; a request whose model does not match is not limited by this policy, and one that names none is counted under the route's default model.

items.name: Request Size Limiter
items.description: Reject requests whose body exceeds configured byte or character limits.

fields.label: Allowed Payload Size
fields.description: Maximum payload size expressed in the selected size unit.

fields.label: Size Unit
fields.description: Unit used to interpret the allowed payload size.

fields.label: Max Characters Per Request
fields.description: Maximum number of UTF-8 characters allowed in the request body.

fields.label: Require Content-Length
fields.description: Reject requests that do not declare a Content-Length header.

items.name: LLM Budget
items.description: Cap LLM spend with token or dollar budgets over time windows, either as one aggregate counter or per-model rules. Applies gateway-wide for global policies, otherwise per consumer. Partition key counts per API key instead.

fields.label: Unit
fields.description: Whether budgets count provider tokens or USD cost.

fields.label: Counting
fields.description: Which usage figure accrues against the budget.

fields.label: Per-Model Rules
fields.description: Per-model budgets. The most specific pattern wins, with an exact model preferred over a wildcard.

fields.label: Model
fields.description: Model slug or wildcard pattern (e.g. claude-opus-*).

fields.label: Max
fields.description: Budget ceiling in tokens or USD, matching the selected unit.

fields.label: Time Window
fields.description: Window duration such as 30s, 30m, 1h, or 1d, one second or longer. calendar_month and calendar_day reset at the start of each UTC month or day.

fields.label: Aggregate Budget
fields.description: Single budget counter for the whole scope, used when per-model rules are not set. Optional with key_budgets, where a personal key's own budget replaces it.

fields.label: Max
fields.description: Budget ceiling in tokens or USD, matching the selected unit.

fields.label: Time Window
fields.description: Window duration such as 30s, 30m, 1h, or 1d, one second or longer. calendar_month and calendar_day reset at the start of each UTC month or day.

fields.label: Behavior On Exceeded
fields.description: Action taken when a budget is exceeded under enforce mode.

fields.label: Downgrade To
fields.description: Target model used when behavior is downgrade_model. Must be on the same provider.

fields.label: Count Cache Reads
fields.description: Include Anthropic cache-read input tokens in counted and costed usage.

fields.label: Custom Pricing
fields.description: Per-token USD rates keyed by model slug or wildcard pattern, consulted before registry pricing and the models.dev catalog. Used for dollar budgets. Not allowed with partition key.

fields.label: Input
fields.description: Input price in USD per token.

fields.label: Output
fields.description: Output price in USD per token.

fields.label: Group By Header
fields.description: Optional request header whose value sub-partitions the budget within the policy scope (e.g. X-User-Id). When empty, the budget is counted per gateway (global) or per consumer. Not allowed with partition key.

fields.label: Partition
fields.description: Set to key to count the budget per API key: per owner when the key has one, so rotating or re-creating it keeps the spend, otherwise per key. Requests without an API key pass uncounted. In enforce mode a key budget fails closed: 503 budget_unavailable when the counter store is unavailable, and 403 model_unpriced on a dollar budget for a model with no catalog or registry price. Not allowed with custom_pricing, group_by_header or behavior_on_exceeded downgrade_model.

fields.label: Key Budgets
fields.description: With partition key, hold each personal key to the budget it carries (set by the console per user) instead of aggregate, when the budget counts in this policy's unit; aggregate then becomes optional, and a key without a budget in this unit is held to aggregate or, without one, not counted. Only a policy with key_budgets reads key budgets.

fields.label: Limit Per
fields.description: What each budget counter belongs to. Absent is shared: one counter for the whole policy scope. application is one per application, api_key one per API key, model one per model, and header one per value of group_by_header. api_key does not limit requests without a key, and application and group do not limit requests without an application.

fields.label: Applies To
fields.description: Whether application limiting covers all applications or only the ones in selected. A request outside the selection is not limited by this policy.

fields.label: Selected
fields.description: Application ids, or group ids with limit_per group, that applies_to selected limits. Required and non-empty with applies_to selected.

fields.label: Only For Models
fields.description: With limit_per model, limit only the models matching one of these patterns (* is a wildcard, e.g. @openai/gpt-6-luna or gpt-5*). Empty limits every model; a request whose model does not match is not limited by this policy, and one that names none is counted under the route's default model.

items.name: Semantic Cache
items.description: Serve cached responses for semantically similar requests, scoped per registry.

fields.label: Similarity Threshold
fields.description: Cosine similarity threshold in (0, 1] required to serve a cache hit.

fields.label: TTL
fields.description: How long cached responses remain valid (e.g. 24h).

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: Embedding provider used to vectorize requests.

fields.label: Model
fields.description: Embedding model name.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Credential for the embedding provider.

items.name: Regex Replace
items.description: Rewrite text with RE2 regular expressions on one leg: the request prompt or the LLM response. Rules apply in declaration order and chain, so each rule sees the previous rule's output. Response rewrites short-circuit later pre-response plugins, so order a response-side instance last in its chain. Whether a response streams is decided by the client request; a streamed response is always rewritten block by block when the rule targets the response, and this cannot be turned off.

fields.label: Target
fields.description: Which leg to rewrite. A single instance rewrites the request prompt or the LLM response, not both.

fields.label: Rules
fields.description: Ordered replacement rules. Each rule's output feeds the next.

fields.label: Pattern
fields.description: RE2 regular expression. Backreferences and lookaround are not supported.

fields.label: Replacement
fields.description: Replacement text. Use $1 or ${name} to reference capture groups. Empty removes the match.

fields.label: Case Insensitive
fields.description: Match without regard to letter case ((?i)).

fields.label: Multiline
fields.description: ^ and $ match at line boundaries ((?m)).
